instruction: Take a picture of the current scene from the video, save it as 'scene.png' to Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation 4: Short filename 'scene.png'. Uses 'take a picture' phrasing.
metadata.verification: Task requires taking a VLC screenshot and saving to scene.png. Evaluator checks if file exists at /home/user/Desktop/scene.png.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies file existence at the specified path (/home/user/Desktop/scene.png)
Getter properly validates PNG format by checking magic bytes (89504e470d0a1a0a), preventing false positives from non-PNG files
Metric correctly verifies file size >= 1KB, preventing empty or corrupted files from passing
Data flow is correct: getter extracts file state (existence, PNG validation, size) and metric performs appropriate checks
Handles edge cases: returns proper values when file doesn't exist or is invalid
Verification logic is semantically sound for the instruction requirements
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor improvement: Could add image dimension checks to verify dimensions are reasonable for a screenshot (e.g., width/height > 100px)
Optional enhancement: Could verify image dimensions match expected screen resolution, but this may be environment-dependent
